detail.longDescription: Mistral introduces Shieldstral, lightweight policy-aware moderation for AI models 🛡️ Mistral AI launches Shieldstral, a lightweight safety model that revolutionizes AI content moderation. This 3B-parameter model handles text & images, achieving 84.9% & 83.8% safety scores respectively. It's game-changing: no retraining needed, works on standard GPUs, and uses natural language policies for context-aware safety verdicts. Perfect for real-time moderation! 🚀 https:// siliconangle.com/2026/08/05/mi stral-introduces-shieldstral-provide-lightweight-policy-aware-moderation-ai-models/ # AI # MachineLearning
